applicability_assumptions.basis: The two obligations are the explicitly bounded architecture-compliance scope in the manually established A0.1 DEVELOPMENT configuration.

pair_evidence_rules.b0_scope_mismatch: If the pinned B0 evaluator execution reports a configured module target that is absent from the pinned A0.1 source inventory, classify only that B0 representation-obligation pair as TEST_ONLY INVALID for scope incompatibility. Preserve the actual process exit code and do not interpret it as an A0.1 architecture violation.
pair_evidence_rules.candidate_semantics: Admit only digest-validated actual evaluator execution records. Do not create positive exact-pair semantic proofs. Candidate pair validity remains UNKNOWN until independently established.

candidate_cost_model.unit: declared development unit; not currency or measured runtime

measurement_rules.evaluator_execution: record each actual subprocess duration, exit status, stdout and stderr digests separately for B0 and A0.1 profile evaluators
measurement_rules.primary_coverage: not established unless independent applicability, denominator and exact-pair semantic evidence are supplied
measurement_rules.controlled_violation: reuse existing PILOT-01 S1 only as a secondary evaluator control; it is not a new architecture transition or independent sample
